import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from statsmodels.tsa.filters.hp_filter import hpfilter

# Load data from all three files
print("Loading data files...")
cpi_data = pd.read_excel('/root/CPI.xlsx')
pce_data = pd.read_excel('/root/ERP-2025-table10.xls', sheet_name='B10', header=None)
pfi_data = pd.read_excel('/root/ERP-2025-table12.xls', sheet_name='B12', header=None)

# Extract CPI data (1973-2024)
# Already has Year and CPI_2024 columns
cpi_df = cpi_data[['Year', 'CPI_2024']].copy()
cpi_df = cpi_df[(cpi_df['Year'] >= 1973) & (cpi_df['Year'] <= 2024)]
print(f"CPI data: {len(cpi_df)} rows from {cpi_df['Year'].min()} to {cpi_df['Year'].max()}")
print(cpi_df.head())

# Extract PCE data from sheet B10
# Annual data starts at row 5 (index 5), column 1 is Total PCE
pce_annual = pce_data.iloc[5:, [0, 1]].copy()
pce_annual.columns = ['Year', 'PCE']
# Clean the Year column (remove trailing period)
pce_annual['Year'] = pce_annual['Year'].astype(str).str.rstrip('.').astype(float).astype(int)
pce_annual['PCE'] = pd.to_numeric(pce_annual['PCE'], errors='coerce')
pce_annual = pce_annual.dropna()
pce_annual = pce_annual[(pce_annual['Year'] >= 1973) & (pce_annual['Year'] <= 2024)]
print(f"\nPCE data: {len(pce_annual)} rows from {pce_annual['Year'].min()} to {pce_annual['Year'].max()}")
print(pce_annual.head())

# Extract PFI data from sheet B12
# Annual data starts at row 6 (index 6), column 1 is Total PFI
pfi_annual = pfi_data.iloc[6:, [0, 1]].copy()
pfi_annual.columns = ['Year', 'PFI']
# Clean the Year column (remove trailing period)
pfi_annual['Year'] = pfi_annual['Year'].astype(str).str.rstrip('.').astype(float).astype(int)
pfi_annual['PFI'] = pd.to_numeric(pfi_annual['PFI'], errors='coerce')
pfi_annual = pfi_annual.dropna()
pfi_annual = pfi_annual[(pfi_annual['Year'] >= 1973) & (pfi_annual['Year'] <= 2024)]
print(f"\nPFI data: {len(pfi_annual)} rows from {pfi_annual['Year'].min()} to {pfi_annual['Year'].max()}")
print(pfi_annual.head())

# Merge all data on Year
merged_df = cpi_df.merge(pce_annual, on='Year').merge(pfi_annual, on='Year')
print(f"\nMerged data: {len(merged_df)} rows")
print(merged_df.head())
print(merged_df.tail())

# Convert to real values (2024 dollars)
# Real Value = (Nominal Value / CPI) * 100
merged_df['PCE_Real'] = (merged_df['PCE'] / merged_df['CPI_2024']) * 100
merged_df['PFI_Real'] = (merged_df['PFI'] / merged_df['CPI_2024']) * 100

print("\nReal values (sample):")
print(merged_df[['Year', 'PCE', 'CPI_2024', 'PCE_Real', 'PFI_Real']].head())

# Take natural logarithm
merged_df['log_PCE_Real'] = np.log(merged_df['PCE_Real'])
merged_df['log_PFI_Real'] = np.log(merged_df['PFI_Real'])

print("\nLogarithmic values (sample):")
print(merged_df[['Year', 'log_PCE_Real', 'log_PFI_Real']].head())

# Apply Hodrick-Prescott filter with lambda=100
print("\nApplying HP filter with lambda=100...")
pce_trend, pce_cycle = hpfilter(merged_df['log_PCE_Real'], lamb=100)
pfi_trend, pfi_cycle = hpfilter(merged_df['log_PFI_Real'], lamb=100)

print(f"PCE cyclical component length: {len(pce_cycle)}")
print(f"PFI cyclical component length: {len(pfi_cycle)}")
print(f"\nPCE cyclical (sample):")
print(pce_cycle[:10])

# Calculate Pearson correlation coefficient
correlation = np.corrcoef(pce_cycle, pfi_cycle)[0, 1]
print(f"\nPearson correlation coefficient (raw): {correlation}")

# Round to 5 decimal places
correlation_rounded = round(correlation, 5)
print(f"Correlation rounded to 5 decimals: {correlation_rounded}")

# Write result to file
with open('/root/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{correlation_rounded:.5f}")

print(f"\nResult written to /root/answer.txt: {correlation_rounded:.5f}")

EOF
